agentResult.response:
Berikut adalah laporan implementasi fitur **Product Category API** pada project backend Golang (`be-golang-app`):

### Ringkasan Implementasi

Sesuai dengan arsitektur **Modular Clean Architecture (3 Layer Baku)**:

1. **Domain Layer** — [`internal/core/domain/category.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/domain/category.go)
   - Mendefinisikan entity [`Category`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/domain/category.go#L9-L13) dengan embedding [`BaseEntity`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/domain/base.go#L5-L11), field `Name` (`varchar(255)`), dan `Description` (`text`), serta method `TableName() string`.
   - Mendefinisikan interface [`CategoryRepository`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/domain/category.go#L19-L24) (`Create`, `FindAll`, `FindByID`, `Delete`) beserta implementasi GORM `NewCategoryRepository`.

2. **Usecase Layer** — `internal/core/usecase/category/`
   - [`dto.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/usecase/category/dto.go): Request DTO ([`CreateCategoryRequest`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/usecase/category/dto.go#L5-L8), [`DeleteCategoryRequest`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/usecase/category/dto.go#L19-L21)) dan Response DTO ([`CategoryResponse`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/usecase/category/dto.go#L10-L17)).
   - [`usecase.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/usecase/category/usecase.go): Interface [`Usecase`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/usecase/category/usecase.go#L14-L18) dan implementasi operasi bisnis `Create`, `List`, serta `Delete` (termasuk validasi input, generate UUID, set timestamp/actor, dan handling `ErrRecordNotFound`).
   - [`usecase_test.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/core/usecase/category/usecase_test.go): Unit tests komprehensif untuk skenario sukses, validasi nama/ID kosong, dan penanganan error repository.

3. **Controller Layer** — `internal/adapter/controller/`
   - [`category.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/adapter/controller/category.go): [`CategoryController`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/adapter/controller/category.go#L16-L20) dengan handler `Create` (POST), `List` (GET), dan `Delete` (DELETE), serta method `Route(router *gin.RouterGroup)` untuk registrasi endpoint `/categories`.
   - [`category_test.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/internal/adapter/controller/category_test.go): Unit dan HTTP mock tests untuk semua endpoint, format status code (201, 200, 400, 404, 500), JSON decoding/validation, serta route wiring test.

4. **Wiring & Migration** — [`cmd/api/api.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-002-20260826t051133z-7f5390e5/cmd/api/api.go)
   - Mendaftarkan `controller.NewCategoryController` ke `start.Register(...)`.
   - Menambahkan auto-migration `start.DB().AutoMigrate(&domain.Category{})`.
